# Development Guide

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+
- pnpm (recommended) or npm
- A Convex account ([dashboard.convex.dev](https://dashboard.convex.dev))

## Initial Setup

### 1. Install dependencies

```bash
pnpm install
```

### 2. Configure local environment

Copy the example environment file:

```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
```

Required variables in `.env.local`:

```env
# Auto-generated by npx convex dev on first run
CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT=dev:your-deployment-name

# Your Convex cloud URL (from dashboard)
NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL=https://your-deployment.convex.cloud

# Your Convex site URL (for auth HTTP routes)
CONVEX_SITE_URL=https://your-deployment.convex.site

# Optional
NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3004
```

### 3. Initialize Convex (first time only)

```bash
npx convex dev
```

This will:

- Prompt you to log in to Convex
- Create or select a project
- Generate `CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT` in your `.env.local`
- Sync your schema and functions

---

## Convex Auth Configuration

This project uses `@convex-dev/auth` with the following providers configured:

| Provider     | Status   | Requirements                           |
| ------------ | -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Password     | Enabled  | None (works out of the box)            |
| Anonymous    | Enabled  | None (works out of the box)            |
| GitHub OAuth | Optional | `AUTH_GITHUB_ID`, `AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET` |
| Google OAuth | Optional | `AUTH_GOOGLE_ID`, `AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET` |

### Auth Architecture

```
convex/
  auth.ts           # Provider configuration (Password, Anonymous, GitHub, Google)
  auth.config.ts    # JWT domain config pointing to CONVEX_SITE_URL
  http.ts           # HTTP router with auth routes
  schema.ts         # Database schema with authTables spread
```

### Required Convex Environment Variables

These must be set in Convex (not local `.env`):

| Variable          | Description                                                        | Required       |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------- |
| `SITE_URL`        | Redirect URL for OAuth/magic links (e.g., `http://localhost:3004`) | Yes, for OAuth |
| `JWT_PRIVATE_KEY` | RS256 private key for signing tokens                               | Auto-generated |
| `JWKS`            | JSON Web Key Set with public key                                   | Auto-generated |

The `JWT_PRIVATE_KEY` and `JWKS` are automatically generated when you run `npx @convex-dev/auth` or set up auth for the first time.

### Setting Up OAuth Providers

#### GitHub OAuth

1. Go to [GitHub Developer Settings](https://github.com/settings/developers)
2. Create a new OAuth App
3. Set Authorization callback URL to: `https://your-deployment.convex.site/api/auth/callback/github`
4. Set the environment variables:

```bash
npx convex env set SITE_URL http://localhost:3004
npx convex env set AUTH_GITHUB_ID your_client_id
npx convex env set AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET your_client_secret
```

#### Google OAuth

1. Go to [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials)
2. Create OAuth 2.0 credentials
3. Add authorized redirect URI: `https://your-deployment.convex.site/api/auth/callback/google`
4. Set the environment variables:

```bash
npx convex env set AUTH_GOOGLE_ID your_client_id
npx convex env set AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET your_client_secret
```

### Managing Convex Environment Variables

```bash
# List all variables
npx convex env list

# Set a variable
npx convex env set VARIABLE_NAME value

# Remove a variable
npx convex env unset VARIABLE_NAME
```

### How Auth Works

1. Client uses `ConvexAuthProvider` from `@convex-dev/auth/react`
2. Auth actions (`signIn`, `signOut`) communicate with Convex HTTP routes
3. JWT tokens are signed with `JWT_PRIVATE_KEY` and verified using `JWKS`
4. Server functions use `getAuthUserId(ctx)` to get the authenticated user
5. `auth.config.ts` configures the domain for token verification

### Auth Tables (auto-created)

The `authTables` spread in `schema.ts` creates:

- `authAccounts` - OAuth/credential accounts linked to users
- `authSessions` - Active user sessions
- `authRefreshTokens` - Token refresh management
- `authVerificationCodes` - Email verification codes
- `authVerifiers` - Verification state

## Running Development

Start both Convex and Next.js:

```bash
pnpm dev
```

This runs concurrently:

- `convex dev` - watches and syncs Convex functions
- `next dev --port 3004` - runs Next.js on port 3004

Access the app at [http://localhost:3004](http://localhost:3004)

---

## Project Structure

```
convex/
  _generated/       # Auto-generated types and API
  auth.ts           # Auth provider setup
  auth.config.ts    # Auth domain configuration
  http.ts           # HTTP routes (auth endpoints)
  schema.ts         # Database schema
  users.ts          # User queries/mutations
  messages.ts       # Chat messages
  presence.ts       # Realtime presence
  files.ts          # File upload handling
  crons.ts          # Scheduled jobs
  cleanup.ts        # Cleanup utilities
```

---

## Commands Reference

| Command                        | Description                         |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------- |
| `pnpm dev`                     | Start dev server (Convex + Next.js) |
| `pnpm build`                   | Production build                    |
| `pnpm lint`                    | Run ESLint                          |
| `pnpm typecheck`               | TypeScript type checking            |
| `pnpm format`                  | Format code with Prettier           |
| `npx convex dev`               | Run Convex dev server only          |
| `npx convex deploy`            | Deploy Convex to production         |
| `npx convex dashboard`         | Open Convex dashboard               |
| `npx convex env list`          | List environment variables          |
| `npx convex env set KEY value` | Set environment variable            |
| `npx convex env unset KEY`     | Remove environment variable         |
| `npx convex logs`              | View function logs                  |
| `npx @convex-dev/auth`         | Initialize/reset auth setup         |

---

## Deploying to Production

### 1. Deploy Convex functions

```bash
npx convex deploy
```

### 2. Set production environment variables

```bash
npx convex env set SITE_URL https://your-production-domain.com --prod
```

### 3. Update OAuth redirect URLs

Update your GitHub/Google OAuth apps to include production callback URLs:

- `https://your-prod-deployment.convex.site/api/auth/callback/github`
- `https://your-prod-deployment.convex.site/api/auth/callback/google`

### 4. Deploy Next.js

Deploy your Next.js app to Vercel or your preferred platform with:

- `NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL` pointing to your production Convex deployment
- `CONVEX_SITE_URL` pointing to your production `.convex.site` URL
